Resolve time is the `at` of the ticket's last audit entry `ticket.transitioned` with `status.to === 'resolved'`, not `ticket.updated` ... Runs only in the background worker, configured by one setting
has exactly one pending `ticket.reminder` outbox event ... further ticks after the reminder, even once it is sent, enqueue nothing more.
a ticket that is open, in_progress or closed is never reminded, however old. ... a ticket reopened or closed before the threshold is not reminded.
verdicts.missing: What counts as the requester responding (no reply endpoint) is not stated; only reopen/close are named as ending the wait.
